note: Machine view of TT_OPTIMIZATIONS.md. Workers cite these ids in TRANSFORMS.json; the controller's search tree records which combinations were tried under which parent. A rejection is bound to its context (parent + combination), never global. Exemplar paths are relative to the TT-Metal checkout (/opt/tt-metal in the sandbox).

categories.dispatch: Remove host/dispatch overhead between device ops
categories.grid: Use the whole Tensix grid in matmuls
categories.memory: Keep data in L1 / near the core that uses it
categories.numerics: Trade precision for speed per op group, measured against the FP32 oracle
categories.kernel: Custom TT kernels (reader/compute/writer) for what stock ops do poorly
categories.scaleout: More than one card or concurrent sub-devices

techniques.title: Metal trace replay of the whole forward
techniques.mechanism: Capture the op sequence once (program cache warm, no allocations during capture) and replay it with execute_trace; op-to-op gaps drop to a few microseconds.
techniques.helps_when: Any fixed-shape forward; largest win when host dispatch dominates (small batch, many small ops).
techniques.risk: hang/wrong output if buffers move or shapes change; keep one live trace per shape

techniques.title: Address-stable device input/output buffers
techniques.mechanism: Allocate inputs/outputs once, copy new data into them (copy_host_to_device_tensor) before each replay.
techniques.helps_when: Required by trace-capture; also removes per-call allocation.
techniques.risk: stale data if a copy is skipped

techniques.title: 2 CQs with events: I/O on CQ1, compute on CQ0
techniques.mechanism: DEVICE_OPTIONS num_command_queues=2; write the next input and read back the previous output on CQ1 while CQ0 replays; synchronize with record/wait events.
techniques.helps_when: Host<->device transfer is a visible share of the step (large inputs/outputs, streaming).
techniques.risk: event ordering bugs; measured ~0 gain on chronos_forecast

techniques.title: Overlap host preprocessing with replay
techniques.mechanism: Prepare/tokenize/pad the next batch on the host while the device runs the current one (non-blocking replay).
techniques.helps_when: Host preprocessing is a measurable share of end-to-end time.

techniques.title: Keep autoregressive control on device
techniques.mechanism: Argmax/sampling, EOS masks and cache updates as device ops so a decode step needs no host readback.
techniques.helps_when: Token-by-token decoders (ITL dominated by readback/dispatch).

techniques.title: Fewer dispatched ops
techniques.mechanism: Algebraic folds, reshapes removed, merged elementwise chains; count ops in the Tracy CSV.
techniques.helps_when: Untraced paths, or when trace is impossible.

techniques.title: 2D multicast matmul with the batch folded into M
techniques.mechanism: MatmulMultiCoreReuseMultiCastProgramConfig(fuse_batch=True, per_core_M/N over the full grid) so B small matmuls become one large one.
techniques.helps_when: Batched encoders/prefill where default configs run B tiny matmuls on part of the grid (chronos_forecast: 2659 -> 922 ms, the largest single win).
techniques.risk: L1 overflow at large per-core blocks

techniques.title: 1D multicast matmul (in0 or in1 mcast)
techniques.mechanism: MatmulMultiCoreReuseMultiCast1DProgramConfig when N (or M) is too small to fill 2D grid columns.
techniques.helps_when: Narrow outputs (heads, projections with small N) or tall-skinny activations.

techniques.title: Tune in0_block_w and output subblocks
techniques.mechanism: in0_block_w >= 2, out_subblock_h*w as large as dst allows (8 tiles, 4 with fp32 dest acc); sweep per shape rather than guess.
techniques.helps_when: After a program config family is chosen; compute-bound matmuls.

techniques.title: DRAM-sharded weights read by the nearest cores
techniques.mechanism: Shard weights across the DRAM banks (create_dram_sharded_mem_config) and use the DRAM-sharded matmul program config.
techniques.helps_when: Small M (decode, batch 1) where matmuls are DRAM-bandwidth bound.

techniques.title: Size the core grid per op
techniques.mechanism: Query device.compute_with_storage_grid_size() (p150 exposes fewer columns than the die) and pick grids that divide the work evenly.
techniques.helps_when: Ops whose tile counts leave cores idle or unbalanced.

techniques.title: Activations resident in L1, processed in chunks
techniques.mechanism: Run the encoder on batch chunks that fit L1 (ttnn.L1_MEMORY_CONFIG), DRAM only between chunks.
techniques.helps_when: Activation traffic to DRAM dominates; chronos_forecast kept L1-interleaved over block-sharded after benchmarking both.

techniques.title: Width/height/block-sharded activations
techniques.mechanism: Shard chains of ops in L1 with matching sharded program configs (matmul, layer_norm, softmax) and avoid interleaved<->sharded conversions.
techniques.helps_when: Long chains of ops on the same layout; encoders like BERT.
techniques.risk: conversion overhead if the chain is short

techniques.title: Deallocate intermediates as soon as possible
techniques.mechanism: ttnn.deallocate dead tensors so larger L1 chunks/blocks fit.
techniques.helps_when: Pushing chunk sizes or L1 residency.

techniques.title: BFP8_B weights (and outputs) per op group
techniques.mechanism: bfloat8_b halves weight bytes; with HiFi2/LoFi matmuls in L1 it is also faster, not only smaller.
techniques.helps_when: DRAM-bound matmuls; together with math-fidelity-ladder.

techniques.title: LoFi / HiFi2 / HiFi4 per op group
techniques.mechanism: LoFi is ~4x and HiFi2 ~2x HiFi4 matmul throughput per core; choose per op group, not globally.
techniques.helps_when: Compute-bound matmuls; pairs with BFP8 operands.

techniques.title: fp32_dest_acc_en where accumulation needs it
techniques.mechanism: FP32 destination accumulation improves long reductions but halves dst tiles (8 -> 4), shrinking matmul subblocks.
techniques.helps_when: Long-K matmuls, norms and softmax that fail accuracy in bf16 accumulation.

techniques.title: packer_l1_acc for K-loop accumulation
techniques.mechanism: Accumulate partial sums in L1 in the packer instead of re-reading.
techniques.helps_when: Matmuls with many K blocks.
techniques.risk: low (disable for SDPA where it hurt)

techniques.title: Approximate SFPU math (exp, gelu, recip)
techniques.mechanism: math_approx_mode / SDPAProgramConfig(exp_approx_mode=True).
techniques.helps_when: Softmax/activation-heavy ops.

techniques.title: Scripted datatype/fidelity sweep per op group
techniques.mechanism: Expose per-group dtype/fidelity knobs (precision_policy groups) and sweep them against the oracle instead of one global choice.
techniques.helps_when: Always after bringup; replaces one-shot global BFP8 trials.

techniques.title: FP32 residual stream
techniques.mechanism: Keep the residual add path in fp32 while sublayers run lower precision.
techniques.helps_when: Unlocks lower precision elsewhere that failed alone.

techniques.title: Activation fused into the matmul
techniques.mechanism: fused_activation=UnaryWithParam(...) in the matmul program config.
techniques.helps_when: Linear followed by GELU/ReLU/SiLU.
techniques.risk: GELU variant must match the model (tanh vs erf)

techniques.title: ttnn.transformer.scaled_dot_product_attention
techniques.mechanism: Flash-style fused attention with SDPAProgramConfig (q/k chunk sizes); one chunk per sequence for short sequences.
techniques.helps_when: Attention over moderate sequence lengths; check mask support against the oracle.

techniques.title: Single QKV matmul plus head split
techniques.mechanism: Concatenate Wq/Wk/Wv, one matmul, then ttnn.experimental.nlp_create_qkv_heads (or a custom QKV+RoPE kernel).
techniques.helps_when: Every attention layer.

techniques.title: Fused rotary embedding with a shared cos/sin cache
techniques.mechanism: Device RoPE op (or custom kernel) with cos/sin computed once and shared across the batch.
techniques.helps_when: Models with RoPE.
techniques.risk: RoPE must be computed in fp32 (scaling variants)

techniques.title: Fold norm gamma (and other constants) into the next linear
techniques.mechanism: W' = diag(gamma) W exactly; removes an elementwise multiply per norm.
techniques.helps_when: Norm followed by a linear.

techniques.title: Native ttnn norms/softmax with explicit compute configs
techniques.mechanism: ttnn.rms_norm / layer_norm / softmax (sharded program configs where applicable) with HiFi4 + fp32 dest acc instead of composed elementwise ops.
techniques.helps_when: Composed norms/softmax are a visible share of op time. Rejected alone in the hackathon on accuracy: retry with fp32-dest-acc, fp32-residual or a different fidelity.

techniques.title: Custom kernel via ttnn.generic_op
techniques.mechanism: KernelDescriptor/CBDescriptor reader-compute-writer kernels for fused elementwise chains, custom norms with low-precision output, or layouts stock ops handle poorly; batch several tiles per NoC barrier.
techniques.helps_when: The profile shows a stock op far from its roofline or a chain of small ops.
techniques.risk: correctness and hangs; Blackhole needs explicit NoC flushes

techniques.title: Bank-local elementwise ops (no NoC traffic)
techniques.mechanism: Each core reads only the tiles in its own L1 bank for residual adds and similar ops.
techniques.helps_when: L1-interleaved elementwise ops.

techniques.title: Multicast shared operands to a core rectangle
techniques.mechanism: One NoC multicast instead of N unicast reads of the same weights/tables (Blackhole supports strided and L-shaped multicast).
techniques.helps_when: Many cores read identical data.

techniques.title: Data parallel across a card mesh
techniques.mechanism: Replicate weights on a MeshDevice and shard the batch (chronos_forecast: 4x p150 ~4.36x).
techniques.helps_when: Throughput objectives with more than one card.
techniques.risk: needs mesh access in the sandbox

techniques.title: Sub-devices with a DRAM prefetcher
techniques.mechanism: Split the grid into sub-devices; a prefetcher streams the next weights into global CBs while compute runs.
techniques.helps_when: DRAM-bound decode on large models.
